derivation: Derived GEOMETRICALLY from the real TY2025 Schedule OI (Form 1040-NR) fillable PDF (IRS file f1040nro.pdf, https://www.irs.gov/pub/irs-pdf/f1040nro.pdf, 93,756 bytes; stored in fixtures under the canonical name f1040soi.pdf): widget /Rects (pypdf) matched against printed item labels from `pdftotext -bbox`, including the item H year labels (2023 x 65-84 / 2024 x 201-220 / 2025 x 354-372, fields immediately to their right) and the item L column header bands ((a) Country x 65-280, (b) article x 281-367, (c) months x 367-461, (d) amount x 461-576). Deliberately NOT mapped (stay blank, covered by packet manifest notes): item B (country of tax residence — not stored separately from citizenship), items C/D1/D2/F/I/J/K and L2/L3 (yes/no questions whose answers are not stored facts), item F's change-description field, item G entry/departure date tables (travel dates are not stored), item L column (c) (months claimed in prior years — not stored), and item M section 871(d) election boxes (no real-property election in scope).

entries.note: 'Name shown on Form 1040-NR' header field, Rect [36, 684, 446, 698]; filled with the stored identity's full name (first + last).
'Your identifying number' header field, Rect [446, 684, 576, 698]; filled digits-only; the fill report value is masked.

Item A answer field ('Of what country or countries were you a citizen or national during the tax year?'), Rect [367, 672, 576, 684] on the printed item-A row (pdftotext -bbox). Filled with the nra block's citizenship exactly as stored (ISO alpha-2 code).

Item E answer field ('enter your visa type ... immigration status on the last day of the tax year'), Rect [252, 576, 497, 588] on the printed item-E row. Filled with the nra block's visa type (the status the determination covers for the whole year).
Item H, days present in 2023: field Rect [86, 420, 194, 432] immediately right of the printed '2023' label (x 65-84, pdftotext -bbox). Fed by Form8843Data.days_present_prior_year_2 when stored.
Item H, days present in 2024: field Rect [223, 420, 331, 432] immediately right of the printed '2024' label (x 201-220). Fed by Form8843Data.days_present_prior_year_1 when stored.
Item H, days present in 2025: field Rect [374, 420, 482, 432] immediately right of the printed '2025' label (x 354-372). Fed by Form8843Data.days_present_current_year when stored.

Item L, row 1, column (a) Country: Rect in the (a) column band (x 65-280, under the printed '(a) Country' header); filled from the engine's Schedule OI entry 1 (treaty country as stored, ISO alpha-2).
Item L, row 1, column (b) Tax treaty article: Rect in the (b) column band (x 281-367); filled from the engine's Schedule OI entry 1 (article as cited, e.g. '20(c)').

Item L, row 1, column (d) Amount of exempt income in current tax year: Rect in the (d) column band (x 461-576); filled from the engine's Schedule OI entry 1. Column (c) (number of months claimed in prior tax years, f1_29/f1_33/f1_37) is deliberately NOT mapped: prior-year claim months are not stored.
